scripts.build:client: npm run build:fonts && esbuild src/client/player.ts src/client/host.ts src/client/arena.ts src/client/dev-sprites.ts src/client/solo/reaction.ts src/client/solo/stopwatch.ts src/client/solo/circle.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --sourcemap --outdir=public/js
scripts.build:fonts: mkdir -p public/fonts && cp node_modules/galmuri/dist/Galmuri11-Bold.woff2 public/fonts/ && cp node_modules/galmuri/dist/LICENSE.txt public/fonts/Galmuri-LICENSE.txt
scripts.build:node: esbuild src/node/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --alias:cloudflare:workers=./src/node/cloudflare-workers.ts --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/server.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run build:client && npm run build:node && node dist/server.mjs
